# The People's Pharmacy

> > Independent health watchdog providing evidence-based drug information, home remedies, and consumer health guidance since 1976 by the Graedons.

The People's Pharmacy is a trusted consumer health resource founded by Joe and Terry Graedon, offering comprehensive drug safety information, natural remedies, and health condition guides. The site reaches over 200,000 weekly listeners through its award-winning podcast and provides accessible medical information to help consumers make informed healthcare decisions.

## Key Topics

- Drug Safety & Side Effects
- Home Remedies & Alternative Medicine
- Medication Interactions
- Health Conditions & Diseases
- Metformin
- Gabapentin
- Tramadol
- Vitamin D
- FDA & CDC Guidelines
- COVID-19
- Alzheimer's Disease
- Consumer Health Advocacy
- Wellness Resources
- Medical Advice
- Pharmacy News

- [Home Remedies](https://www.peoplespharmacy.com/home-remedies): Collection of natural remedies and alternative medicine resources
- [Health Concerns Index](https://www.peoplespharmacy.com/health-concerns): Alphabetical index of 10,000+ articles on health conditions

- [Will High-Dose Vitamin D Fight COVID-19?](https://www.peoplespharmacy.com/articles/will-high-dose-vitamin-d-fight-covid-19): Article on vitamin D supplementation for COVID-19 prevention
